title: Love Your Neighbor as Yourself
reflectionText: Loving your neighbor here looks like leaving grain in the field for the poor, paying a worker before nightfall, judging fairly, refusing to slander, and reproving a brother honestly instead of hating him. Five times the same refrain lands: I am Yahweh. Which of these very specific loves is the one you would rather keep vague?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production, Batch E completion pass. Leviticus 19:9-18 ONLY (boundary not widened). Owner-approved shortScripture:true — naturally 240w WEB / 243w KJV from a 239-word command list; not padded. Retains gleaning-for-poor-and-foreigner, and the prohibitions on stealing/lying/false swearing/oppression/withheld wages/cursing the deaf/stumbling block before the blind, impartial judgment, and against hatred and vengeance; ends on 'love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh' (19:18). Reproof is kept as a command (19:17), so correction is not framed as hatred; the commands are not softened into vague niceness and not made into a political platform. WEB 'Yahweh'; KJV 'the Lord'. Narrator VOICE_PRISCILLA_TEACHER, mood encouraging (owner-approved). CORRECTION 2026-07-27 (owner/ChatGPT review): the 19:16b clause now reads 'Do not endanger the life of your neighbor' (closer to the source than the prior 'do not stand by while your neighbor's life is in danger', which implied a bystander duty the verse does not state). TEXT APPROVED — AUDIO AUTHORIZED BY OWNER ON 2026-07-29; that approval covers the pre-repair KJV short lane and its render. CATEGORY RULING 2026-08-06: Leviticus 19:9-18 is DIVINE LEGAL PROCLAMATION — apodictic law spoken in the first person and sealed by the fivefold refrain, with no narrative action inside the anchor; it remains in the Traditional product and is not reclassified. The KJV short lane was re-authored on 2026-08-06 under ADR-031: the prior text was a near-verbatim transcription differing from the KJV passage by five word-level edits, 241 of 243 tokens matched with a single 165-token uninterrupted run, so its technical Reconstruction pass did not establish Level 2 craft. Repaired as a proclamation-oriented retelling on the individual-command-with-scope standard — the Lord established as speaker in the opening line, the ye/thou address explained, KJV periods divided into spoken beats, referents re-anchored, the five refrains kept as audible panel endings. Every command, condition, beneficiary, deadline and refrain is preserved; 'by my name', 'all night until the morning', the deaf/blind pairing, both sides of the impartiality command, 'thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour' and 'thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself' remain exact, and 19:16b is not softened. No scene, explanation, application or material outside the anchor. shortScripture:true retained (story-level; the untouched WEB lane is 240w). The rendered KJV story audio predates this repair and is now stale; it was preserved unchanged and no new audio is authorized. WEB lane, both reflections and both Scripture extracts are unchanged. The repaired KJV text awaits Adam and ChatGPT review; no text lock is claimed.
